gloss: ascending and descending; going up and down

definitions.gloss: ascending and descending; going up and down
definitions.explanation: The action of moving up and down, typically referring to riding elevators, climbing stairs, or the mechanical raising and lowering of equipment.

examples.japanese: {昇降|しょうこう}{口|ぐち}はどこですか。
エレベーターが{昇降|しょうこう}する{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of the elevator going up and down.

examples.japanese: {階段|かいだん}の{昇降|しょうこう}が{困難|こんなん}な{方|かた}は、エレベーターをご{利用|りよう}ください。
examples.english: Those who have difficulty going up and down stairs, please use the elevator.

notes:
USAGE:
{昇降|しょうこう} is a formal compound combining {昇|のぼ}る (to ascend) and {降|お}りる (to descend). It appears frequently in signage, instructions, and technical descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昇降|しょうこう}{口|ぐち} (entrance/exit for boarding, as on a bus or train platform)
- {昇降|しょうこう}{機|き} (elevator, lift mechanism)
- {昇降|しょうこう}{式|しき} (height-adjustable, as in {昇降|しょうこう}{式|しき}デスク — standing desk)
